output_list.criticism: This vulnerability is partially exploitable and has high severity. Since it requires no input parameter, the attacker can easily seize all tokens by exploiting this vulnerability. The foundation can easily transfer all tokens to themselves which makes this vulnerability exploitable. Further, foundation can be easily controlled by attacker due to its control over token transfer. It will result in loss of tokens for the foundation which is critical for this smart contract.

This vulnerability is partially exploitable and has high severity. Since it requires no input parameter, the attacker can easily seize all tokens by exploiting this vulnerability. The function approveAndCallcode is called by anyone, not only by owner. The function approveAndCallcode has an extra parameter _extraData which attacker can use to exploit this vulnerability. This vulnerability makes attacker have more leverage on this smart contract. Further, foundation can be easily controlled by attacker due to its control over token transfer. It will result in loss of tokens for the foundation which is critical for this smart contract.
